summary: Snapshot Put must write a unique temp file in the store directory, fsync it, rename into place, and fsync the directory so a crash cannot leave truncated JSON or a lost directory entry that Get treats as missing.
reason: new-since's whole product is the persisted id set. Get treats malformed JSON as a missing snapshot, so a partial write makes the next run look like a first seed and re-report every previously seen item as new.
